title: What the 12-month project can honestly reach
body: Definitions follow the standard Horizon Europe TRL scale quoted in Annex 1.1. The funded path ends at TRL7 with a portable or simply cart-mounted unit.

levels.name: Basic principles observed
levels.text: Leaf symptoms on cereals are visible in RGB photographs and can be photographed in repeatable ways.
levels.note: No supporting historical evidence has been supplied for this page.

levels.name: Technology concept formulated
levels.text: A portable edge device that photographs, infers, records uncertainty and hands each result to a human reviewer.
levels.note: No supporting historical evidence has been supplied for this page.

levels.name: Experimental proof of concept
levels.text: Inference on the Jetson with a trained classifier on historical images.
levels.note: No supporting historical evidence has been supplied for this page. The historical-source recheck is listed under Evidence with its limits.

levels.name: Technology validated in lab
levels.text: A bounded scouting application validated in the lab. It runs on the existing Jetson with an identified camera, GPS handling and GPU inference, and produces reviewed observations and reproducible evidence.
levels.note: Annex 1 eligibility criterion 14 requires a starting TRL of at least 4. Supply the evidence before the application is submitted.

levels.name: Technology validated in relevant environment
levels.text: The same workflow validated in a relevant agricultural environment, including acquisition quality and performance assessed by independent reviewers.

levels.name: Technology demonstrated in relevant environment
levels.text: An integrated prototype using programme data and interfaces (M4 outputs, Data Cube, IoT Observatory), demonstrated with end users in representative conditions.

levels.name: System prototype demonstration in operational environment
levels.text: The bounded application demonstrated in an operational workflow at the programme site with farmers and advisors. The unit is portable or mounted on a simple supervised cart.

beyond.text: The field unit as a payload on an existing tramline carrier, supervised on site
Aerial surveys flag patches; the carrier photographs them for review
Research on leaf sampling with an arm for laboratory confirmation, only where task value, reliability, safety and economics justify it

beyondNote: These are indicative planning windows, not achieved or committed milestones.
